workflow_completion.note: Report produced without an exception and its status equals the expected status.

risk_agreement.note: Report risk category equals the category derived by hand from the documented rules (design.md 8.2). Not clinical validation.

safety_pass.note: Report verification status (passed / failed / not_run) equals the expected status.

weather_extraction.note: Report weather fields equal to the synthetic fixture within 0.05; null fixture values must be null and listed as missing.

source_verification.note: Plan items whose source ids are all in TRUSTED_SOURCES.

items_verified.note: Plan items that passed the deterministic safety checks.

delegation_order_effective.note: Successful coordinator and deterministic-fallback delegations, in step order, equal the expected path (fallback allowed).

delegation_order_model_driven.note: Expected order reached by the coordinator model alone: no fallback step, no steering block, finalize_report called by the model.

language_notice.note: Non-English request returns an English plan with a language notice.

timing_ms.note: Wall-clock time of one coordinator run (perf_counter).

adversarial_direct_rejection.note: Unsafe item injected into a real plan: verification fails, the item is not verified and the original items stay verified (deterministic run_checks).

adversarial_controls_pass.note: Safe control item injected into the same plan: verification still passes.

adversarial_end_to_end.note: Planner model adds unsafe text on both attempts (scripted): report ends needs_human_review after one revision and the unsafe text is absent from the exported checklist.
